title: FaceRecord
description: Normative. One face of a font file, as streamed by `fpengine scan` in the `face` event: fpengine.records.face_record (WP-106) with `path` replaced by the request string. contracts.md section 3 plus `unshaped`. The helper emits exactly these keys, in this order. Readers ignore keys they do not know.

path.description: The file path exactly as given in the scan request.

index.description: Face index inside a .ttc/.otc; 0 for single-font files.

size.description: File size in bytes (os.stat st_size at scan time).

mtime.description: os.stat st_mtime at scan time, seconds since the Unix epoch, as a float. Compare with other clocks using a tolerance of 1e-3 s.

postscript_name.description: Name ID 6, or null when the face has none.

local_names.description: Native family names, most useful first (catalog/face.py:_local_names ranking after WP-108).

axes.description: fvar axes in font order; empty for static faces.

weight_class.description: OS/2 usWeightClass. When there is no OS/2 table: 700 if head.macStyle bit 0 (bold) is set, else 400 (engine-correctness.md WP-103).

coverage.description: The code points of the face's best cmap (WP-101 semantics).

group_counts.description: Characters per script group; only non-empty groups, keys in GROUPS order. Counts plannable coverage once WP-107 lands (engine-metadata.md S4).

fs_type.description: Raw OS/2 fsType; null when there is no OS/2 table.

unsupported_reason.description: Plain-language reason when supported is false; null otherwise.

hidden.description: Family or PostScript name starts with '.' (ENGINE-10, CATALOG-2).

suspicious_coverage.description: The cmap maps far more code points than there are glyphs (e.g. .LastResort); never suggested.

ot_scripts.description: OpenType ScriptList tags, each list sorted and unique.

shapes_groups.description: Complex script groups this face can shape (ADR-0008 rule, WP-107), in GROUPS order.

is_forged.description: Name ID 0 starts with the forged-font marker 'Forged with Font Playground' (contracts.md section 6).

unshaped.description: Code points the face maps but cannot shape correctly (engine-metadata.md WP-107; empty before it). Plannable coverage = coverage minus unshaped. Proposed contracts.md section 3 addition.
